title: Open the application ERD and compare a proposed overlay
preconditions: Disposable format-2 Saga using the PDF inventory fixture: implemented PDF report held by Record store, proposed JSON PDF job held by Job queue, report-to-job production relationship, application ERD, and pdf-jobs overlay; the reporting ERD also includes a job association with owner 0..many and destination unknown.

steps.action: Open Technical design, follow Data model, then open the application ERD.
steps.expected_result: The application ERD entry and authored baseline report are readable.

steps.action: Open the pdf-jobs overlay and then reopen the baseline application ERD.
steps.expected_result: The overlay shows the added job and production relationship, links baseline r1, and leaves the baseline directory unchanged.

steps.action: From the selected design follow its declared feature and design links.
steps.expected_result: The originating feature and committed design are identifiable without changing the baseline.

expected_result: The originating feature and committed design are identifiable without changing the baseline.
